Still on chain, still frozen, not migrated, nothing points at it. Its 57,500,000 SS4 (sale + bonus pools) remain locked in it.

Nothing was ever bought on it. Still on chain, still frozen, not migrated, nothing points at it. Its 57,500,000 SS4 (sale + bonus pools) remain locked in it.
